summary: Verified validation task wrapper behavior with unit tests, full regression, guardrails and CLI smoke.

verification_claims.claim: Dry-run writes structured planned real-lake-readonly evidence without executing commands.
Executed successful reruns record matching output hashes and PASS consistency.
Forbidden operation counters fail the validation task when write counts are non-zero.
CLI smoke works through meta-flow validation run.

commands.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run meta-flow validation run --cr CR-043-SMOKE --profile real-lake-readonly --reruns 2 --project-root /tmp/meta-flow-validation-smoke-2
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run meta-flow cr check --project-root .

remaining_risks.reason: The wrapper standardizes evidence; each target project still owns its validation command and output contract.
Planned evidence is intentionally not real validation evidence. CP7 promise/evidence gates must consume executed run refs.
